title: Listen and Choose a Response — At the Gym

questions.stem: The spin class I wanted was already full when I signed up.

options.A: I spin the dial to set the timer.
options.B: It was full of interesting people.
options.C: Yes, I'll sign the form for you.
options.D: There's another one on Thursday evenings, isn't there?

questions.explanation: Suggesting an alternative class responds naturally to the disappointment. The others reuse 'spin', 'full', and 'sign' in different senses.
questions.speaker: f3
